description: Department Of Fiscal Policy - The Finance Act, No.25 of 2003 Order Under Section 2(1)
categorisation: This gazette contains an order issued under the Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003 that amends airport departure fees and exemptions. It involves regulatory changes to existing legislation through statutory instruments, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing regulatory amendments.
